title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:

A former food services administrator is accused of taking bribes; a man and his son target people facing foreclosure.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E4 — The Ties That Bind
The relationships formed between inmates inside and outside of jail often take unexpected turns.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E1 — Predatory Behavior
To their victims, they were epitome of terror and the face of their nightmares; five of the most notorious inmates to ever appear on Lockup reveal startling insights into their shocking brands of predatory behavior.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E5 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Rodrick, Morris
More than three thousand kids pass through the juvenile courts in Lake County, Indiana each year; here, consequences can range from a sleepless night in detention to the ultimate punishment for kids who keep coming back: Boys' School.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E1 — A Young People's Guide to Jail
An exploration of first-time inmates that look like they should be sitting in classrooms rather than jail cells.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Piece of Cake
An inmate with a record dating back to age 14 comes to terms with his past and present; another inmate is left cut and bleeding after he is caught off guard during a vicious assault inside the Kent County Jail.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Outcast
Behind the circular walls of Kent County Jail an inmate tries to leave jail the hard way; a female inmate convicted of her fifth drunken driving charge could lose everything; an outcast inmate makes a comment that sparks both violence and panic.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Snitch-innati
A jail shakedown recovers a huge stash of contraband; a young couple is charged with robbery and murder, but as judgment day approaches, one of their lives might depend on the choices of another.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E3 — Raffaello Follieri
An Italian real estate developer romances a Hollywood starlet and misappropriates investor funds.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S1 E5 — Phony Phone Calls; Heavy Metal Fraud
A man is accused of bilking $37 million from thousands of investors by selling investments in payphones that don't exist; a recently paroled telemarketer solicits investments in precious metals.

A former food services administrator is accused of taking bribes; a man and his son target people facing foreclosure.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E7 — Hardcore
Producers offer candid interviews and previously unaired footage of some of the most hardcore prison stories.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — X'd Out
In San Antonio, Texas, rival gangs shed blood in a power struggle to control a wide range of criminal activity including drugs, prostitution and human trafficking; this turf war has expanded from the streets to inside the walls of Bexar County Jail.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Defiance
Gang members disrupt a housing unit, and when inmates flood their cells, the Special Emergency Response Team, or SERT, takes action, placing one inmate in special restraints; a female inmate poses a dangerous threat to staff.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Dirt Roads and Trouble
A young woman finds love in the jail's one co-ed housing unit; another inmate, charged with a spree of armed robberies, now comes under investigation inside the jail; a father speaks for his son, who if found guilty, could face the death penalty.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — For Better or Worse
Alcohol is not allowed inside Indiana State Prison; that doesn't stop the inmates from making it, or correctional officers from confiscating it; in past years, the most common forms of contraband were drugs or tobacco; today it's cell phones.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Shackled Love
One inmate's troubled past leads to angry outbursts inside the jail, while another arrives after an alleged crime spree that sounds like it's right out of a movie; a young mother could go to prison if she's found guilty of robbery.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Bad Good Friday
A murderous shooting spree erupts on a major religious holiday; a new inmate catches the jail staff's attention; a father of five receives haunting news from home.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Brother Against Brother
The arrest of two brothers in the murders of four women.
